_doc: House pacing standard v3.0 (corpus-calibrated from 41 SCRIPT_YOUTUBE folders, 2026-11-24): native 1.0x Hải Đăng rhythm (~4.70 target_ups in speech, 4.00-4.65 overall wps with natural 20-24% pause breathing room, pitch_ratio 1.00), concise 450-660w Short scripts (sweet spot 500-620w), and breathable 2.3-3.8 s/shot cutting pace. Shared across episodes; do not edit per episode. Enforced by script_lint.py (G2), voice.py/sv_gate G3, lint.mjs shots PC-01..03 (G5), and deliver report (G7).

calibration._doc: v3.0 empirical calibration from 28 pure VN 9:16 reference Shorts (ref_short_vn) + 6 16:9 Long-Form scripts in G:\My Drive\SCRIPT_YOUTUBE (2026-11-24)

voice._speed_why: v3.0 Native 1.0x Hải Đăng (Option B1): native VieNeu Hải Đăng naturally speaks at 4.64-4.69 ups. Setting target_ups=4.70, blend_raw=0.65, pitch_ratio=1.00, tempo_clamp=[0.95, 1.08] eliminates artificial 1.14-1.42x WSOLA speedup while generous intra/inter-sentence pauses (0.24s/0.30s, inside_pause >0.55s -> 0.25s) restore 20-24% real audio breathing room.

episode._why: Concise 1.75-2.65 minute vertical Short (~2.25 min target = 135 s). At ~4.25-4.50 overall wps (native 4.70 in-speech ups + natural 20-24% pauses), 450-660 spoken words (sweet spot 500-620w, matching ref_short_vn median 595w) run 105-160 s without rushing or rambling.

episode_long._doc: OPT-IN length band for an adapted source story the USER asked to keep longer than 2.5 min. Needs script.json "length": "long" AND brief.md '## Length override' with user_quote (script_lint SC-27).

episode_long_16x9._doc: 6.5-15.0 minute 16:9 long-form kid-friendly adventure story (sv-02-long-form), built Unit-by-Unit across 4-9 standalone episodic chapters at native 1.0x Hải Đăng (4.70 ups, zero artificial speedups). Floor lowered from 2600 -> 1700w to cover the 6 reference long-form scripts (1737-2614w, median 2423w). Needs script.json "length": "long_16x9" AND "format": "16:9" AND "units": [...] AND brief.md '## Length override' with user_quote.

shots._why: Corpus-calibrated 9:16 cutting pace (ref_short_vn median 50 shots, 2.98 s/shot, 20.1 shots/min). Cuts land on word anchors plus 2-4 deliberate silent visual hold beats (0.5-1.2 s) at hooks, reveals, and buttons.

shots_long_16x9._why: 16:9 cinematic episodes alternate crisp 1.8-3.2 s close-up/reaction/POV cuts with rich 4.0-6.5 s dynamic tracking/action shots across multi-angle & multi-scale sets.
